Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Presented to the maintainer in batch #408 as item 3 of 5 — the three leftovers the devx seat put to the maintainer in 6433458746 after PR #26032 landed. Seat increment (re-read 2026-10-27T04:45Z):
- The live lane (workflow id 296377215, "informational"): **99 success / 1 unfinished of the 100 newest runs since 10-20**, median 1.4 min per the card; the allowlist `test:e2e:live:ci` (`ui/package.json:121`) runs 4 of the 22 specs in `ui/e2e/live` (22 files counted). So Q1's gate would be a check that is green 99% of the time and costs 1.4 min, already running on every PR.
- Half-state: `needs-user-decision` alone; the ruling's stroke returns the card to `pm:queue` for the chosen items.
- Facets (seat's reading): ① a console-against-a-real-backend smoke that counts is the test the required e2e lacks (the required e2e asserts geometry on a backend-less preview); ② 99/100 green, 1.4 min, no runtime added; ③ a required check refuses loudly, an informational lane is read by nobody (the card measured 487 runs in 7 days, unread); ④ Q1 is a new gate (the maintainer's flip), Q2 is redundant once Q1 holds, Q3 is remove-or-wire.
- The seat's letters: **Q1 A** promote the 4-spec live lane to a required context (Tier H + ruleset enrolment, as `Lint UI` was on 10-26); **Q2 no** daily lane (it already runs per PR; a daily copy adds nothing once required); **Q3 B** triage the 18 unrun specs by objectui#13104's list — delete the stale ones, wire the rest into Nightly Tiers so a red files a card. Not Q1 B/C (keeping it informational keeps the gap). Workload: devx · 1 Tier H PR (Q1, with the maintainer's ruleset click) + ui · 1 PR (Q3) · S each.
Prior rulings read: live-e2e informational · required e2e → #25752 step 6; objectui#13104; 「新增门禁默认否」; thread: 6433458746.

Ruling: batch #408 item 3 · letters Q1 A · Q2 no · Q3 B · maintainer 「批 #408  同意」 2026-10-27T06:26Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batch #408 with 「批 #408  同意」 — every seat letter. Brief 6433970316; the devx release 6433458746 asked the three questions.

- **Q1 A — the four-spec live lane becomes a required context.** The maintainer's yes is the explicit flip of 「新增门禁默认否」 for this one check: the `test:e2e:live:ci` allowlist (`ui/package.json:121`, four specs, 99 green of the 100 newest runs since 10-20, ~1.4 min) runs as a job whose `name:` is enrolled in `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` and in the ruleset by the maintainer in the same sitting as the merge. It already runs on every PR; what changes is that a red refuses.
- **Q2 no** — no daily lane: once required it runs on every PR and in the queue; a daily copy adds nothing.
- **Q3 B — the 18 live specs that run nowhere are triaged by objectui#13104's list:** the stale ones deleted, the rest wired into Nightly Tiers (`*.live.test.*` or the lane's equivalent) so a red files a card through that job's report step. Not Q3 A (delete all) and not Q3 C (wire all unread).

Workload: Q1 devx · 1 Tier H PR (`.github/workflows/**`) + the maintainer's ruleset click · S; Q3 ui · 1 PR · S (measured per spec on the PR).

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:devx`, p3; the Q3 half is `domain:ui`'s and may be split off as a child by the first seat that claims). `Ruling-ref:` names this comment. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Deferral reading · `domain:devx#1` (#6023) · `session_01JQwxbaFpnMwgpCgneKe2qS` · 2026-10-27T21:55Z · ⛔ not a claim, no state change

The seat read this card for a refill and did not take it this round. Read at `origin/main` today:

- **The ruling's premise moved.** Ruling 6435339772 made the four-spec live lane required on the reading that it "already runs on every PR" (99 of 100 green, ~1.4 min). That was objectui's `live-e2e.yml`. Since #26058 deleted `ui/.github/workflows/**`, no root workflow runs `test:e2e:live:ci` (`git grep` over `.github` finds no carrier for it or `playwright.live.config.ts`), and PR #26854's body records the same: "Row 17 `live-e2e`: no root carrier". So Q1 A now means a new job that boots a backend and the console, not a flip of an existing check. Its green rate and cost on this tree are unmeasured.
- **It is serial behind PR #26854.** That Tier H PR (#26717, `domain:skills#1`) edits the same `ci.yml` `build-e2e-ui` region and is waiting for approvers.
- **#26717's roster says the opposite for row 17.** Its table marks `live-e2e.yml` "retire unless a seat owns reading it". This card's ruling, which came earlier, says required. The seat is noting this on #26717 so the next roster card does not retire the lane.

Whoever picks this up after #26854 lands should first measure the four specs on this tree against an `app-showcase` boot, reporting green rate and wall time. Then write the Tier H job and enroll its `name:` in `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`, leaving the ruleset click to the maintainer. The Q3 half (the 18 unrun specs) is `domain:ui`'s.
